articles.desc: BESANÇON, France — The French Army’s Future Combat Command is seeking ways to create “opacity” on an increasingly transparent battlefield in order to restore offensive maneuver , looking at everything from physical decoys to electronic warfare and electromagnetic deception, said Gen. articles.title: Merz wirbt für Sozialreformen

articles.title: Decoding the DNA switches behind gene regulation
articles.desc: Understanding gene regulation may be key to interpreting human disease genetics. Genes are regulated in part by stretches of DNA called enhancers, which define when, where and how strongly each gene is turned on. Mapping enhancers and how they function in specific cell types is necessary for understanding gene regulation and disease-related genetic variants. But the location and activity of enhancers are highly cell type-specific, making it difficult to accurately predict enhancer–gene interactions.
